Calendar year creation should copy the correct season, and Entry Fees years should be ordered consistently

AreaSettings → Memberships, Insurance, Entry Fees
PriorityMedium (proposed; confirm with team)
EnvironmentTour Manager environment shown in attached screen recording (exact build not verified)

Issue 1 — Add calendar year should use the season's last year

Description: When creating a new calendar year in Memberships, Insurance, or Entry Fees, the new year's values should be based on the last year of the selected season and copied from the currently open season. The behavior should be consistent across all three Settings areas.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Tour Manager → Settings.
  2. Open Memberships, Insurance, or Entry Fees.
  3. Select a season that spans two calendar years.
  4. Review the current prices/settings and click + Add calendar year.
  5. Review the proposed year and the values that will be copied. Repeat in the other two sections.

Expected result

  • The added calendar year corresponds to the last year of the selected season.
  • The new year's membership prices, insurance prices/settings, or entry fees are prefilled from the current open season, respectively.
  • Values remain editable before saving, and the same behavior applies in all three sections.

Actual / observed

The recording demonstrates navigating between the three settings tabs, selecting years, and using + Add calendar year. In Entry Fees, the new-season dialog and a notice about copying prior-year prices are visible. The requested source-year rule and cross-tab consistency require correction/verification. The recording alone does not prove the saved values across all three tabs; verify using UI and API before marking a confirmed data-copy defect.

Example from the video

The Entry Fees screen shows a selected multi-year season and the New season dialog with the Create season action. The UI also displays a copy-prices notice. For a season labeled 2025–26, the target calendar year should be 2026 (the last year), and values should come from the current open season rather than an unrelated calendar year. This is an illustration of the expected rule, not a claim that this exact season was saved incorrectly in the recording.

Issue 2 — Entry Fees dropdown year ordering is inconsistent

Description: The Entry Fees year dropdown should follow the same chronological order as the Memberships and Insurance year dropdowns.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Go to Settings → Entry Fees.
  2. Open the season/year dropdown.
  3. Compare the order with Memberships and Insurance.

Expected result

Years appear in ascending chronological order, oldest to newest, consistently across the three sections.

Actual result

The recording shows the Entry Fees dropdown listing years in a different order from the expected oldest-to-newest convention. The year selection order should be standardized.

Impact

Inconsistent year creation/copy behavior can cause incorrect or missing membership, insurance, or entry-fee configurations. An inconsistent dropdown order makes it harder for Tour Managers to locate the intended season.

Acceptance criteria

  1. For a season spanning two calendar years, + Add calendar year uses its final year.
  2. New year values copy from the current open season for Memberships, Insurance, and Entry Fees.
  3. Copied values are visible and editable before saving.
  4. Entry Fees years display oldest to newest, matching the other sections.
  5. Changing or creating a year does not overwrite another existing year's saved values.
